approach: Add one shared precondition in `crates/athena-core/src/land.rs`: `refuse_detached(git, &Dispatched)`, which bails when `Git::current_branch()` is `None`. The message names the detached commit (12-char sha) and the expected branch from the job's `dispatch_branch`, says "nothing landed", and has no "verification" wording. Call it in two places. (1) `Athena::land_or_block` in `run/close.rs`, right after the repository lock and before the attempt loop, so no score, closing commit or stale outcome is built for a detached HEAD. (2) `RealSteps::land` in `crates/athena-cli/src/drain.rs`, before `self.lander.land`. This is the drain's PR landing step. Its `land_pr` loads records at a detached HEAD, can fail with "job has no verification; it cannot be landed" (gh/landing.rs:855), and is where the reported misleading error most likely arose. The drain step also refuses a different checked-out branch with a message naming both branches, because nothing else catches that there. `land_or_block` keeps its existing `Plan::OtherBranch` handling for a different branch (stale outcome or bail), so existing tests keep their meaning. To find the expected branch when the detached HEAD lacks the job's records, add `dispatched_from(git, head, id)` in land.rs. It reads `dispatch_branch` from the records at HEAD. If HEAD lacks the job, it reads `job.json` from the first local branch (`for-each-ref refs/heads`) whose tip holds it. If none holds it, the result is `Dispatched::Unknown`, which still refuses a detached HEAD but names no branch. `gh/landing.rs`, stale rules, merge-tree and fingerprint are untouched. Tests: a lifecycle test detaches HEAD in the existing `Scenario.during_verification` hook and calls `athena.go`. A drain test calls `RealSteps::land` with a recording lander. Land.rs gets unit tests for the helper. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased/Fixed line with the root cause.

decisions.choice: Fix at the landing precondition with a shared helper in land.rs, called from land_or_block and from RealSteps::land, instead of editing plan() or the OtherBranch mapping.
decisions.reason: The fault starts where landing proceeds without asking whether the working copy is on a branch. In land_or_block a detached HEAD becomes a recorded stale outcome committed onto the detached HEAD (holds_job is true when HEAD is at the tip), or a generic bail. In the drain's PR step it becomes `job has no verification` (gh/landing.rs:855) when records are read at a detached HEAD. A check before either step fixes both with one message.

rejected.option: Change Plan::OtherBranch handling so detached HEAD returns an error from plan()
rejected.why: plan() runs inside the attempt loop after the score is built, and it is also used by retry_landing. The brief wants the refusal before any closing commit or stale outcome is built.

rejected.option: Edit gh/landing.rs land_pr to check the branch
rejected.why: The brief lists the --pr landing path as out of scope. The drain-side check sits in drain.rs before land_pr is called.

decisions.choice: In land_or_block refuse only a detached HEAD, and leave a different checked-out branch to plan()'s existing OtherBranch path.
decisions.reason: The request and criteria are about the detached case. The tests a_job_finished_on_a_branch_with_its_records_goes_stale and a_job_finished_on_a_branch_without_its_records_changes_nothing pin the current outcomes for another branch (a stale record or a bail naming `main` and `other`). The message there already names both branches.

rejected.option: Make every off-branch state a hard bail in land_or_block
rejected.why: It changes the stale outcome those tests assert and is a behavior change beyond the request.

decisions.choice: The drain step refuses both a detached HEAD and a different branch before calling the lander.
decisions.reason: There is no stale-outcome path at that step. A landing commit made on the dispatch branch cannot be found by land_pr's landed_commit_for(HEAD) from any other checkout. The check turns that into a clear error naming the actual HEAD state and the expected branch.

rejected.option: Check only detached HEAD in the drain too
rejected.why: The request says the branch must match the drain branch. A different branch at that step gives the same confusing downstream error.

decisions.choice: Do not add a field to RealSteps or Athena. Derive the expected branch from the job record (dispatch_branch), with a fallback scan of local branches for the job's job.json.
decisions.reason: More than 30 tests build `RealSteps { .. }` literals (tests/drain.rs, job_plan.rs:173, focus.rs:159), so a new field would break them all. No separate drain-branch setting exists in the code I read. The job's dispatch branch is the branch the drain works on.

rejected.option: Capture the branch at drain start in RealSteps::live
rejected.why: It needs a new field, which breaks every struct-literal test and makes the check depend on how the steps were built.
A HEAD detached on an older commit lacks the job's records, which is the incident's shape. The expected branch would then be unnamed.

decisions.choice: A detached HEAD is refused for every dispatch kind: Branch, Detached, and Unknown (old records). The message names the expected branch when one is recorded and says 'a checked-out branch' otherwise.
decisions.reason: The request says HEAD must not be detached. A job dispatched on a detached HEAD already never lands (it became a stale outcome); it now stops with a clear error instead. No existing test lands from a detached HEAD (grep of crates for --detach found only reconcile and land.rs plan() tests).

rejected.option: Skip the check for Dispatched::Detached and Unknown
rejected.why: Leaves the commit-onto-detached-HEAD path open for those jobs.

files.purpose: Add pub fn refuse_detached(git, &Dispatched) -> Result<()> and pub fn dispatched_from(git, head, id) -> Result<Dispatched> (record at HEAD, else local-branch scan). Update the module doc with the working-copy precondition. Add unit tests for detached/branch/unknown and the fallback.
In land_or_block, call crate::land::refuse_detached(&self.git, &dispatched)? after lock_repository and the dispatched computation, before the `for _attempt` loop. Import the helper.

In RealSteps::land, before self.lander.land, compute the expected branch with athena_core::land::dispatched_from and refuse a detached HEAD (refuse_detached) or a different branch, returning Landing::NotLanded(message) and removing the table row as the existing path does.

Add a_detached_head_at_landing_is_refused_naming_the_head_and_the_branch (detach in during_verification; Err with 'detached' and `main`; tip unchanged; no landing; job interrupted) and a_job_lands_when_head_is_on_the_dispatch_branch.

Add the_drain_step_refuses_to_land_from_a_detached_head and the_drain_step_lands_from_the_dispatch_branch, using RealSteps::land with RecordingLander after athena.go; add a case for a different branch.

One Fixed entry under [Unreleased] naming the root cause: landing did not check the working copy was on the branch before proceeding, so a detached HEAD surfaced as a missing verification or a stale outcome.

steps: land.rs: add `refuse_detached(git: &Git, expected: &Dispatched) -> Result<()>`. Call git.current_branch()?; on None read `git.head()?`, take the first 12 chars, and bail with `the working copy's HEAD is detached at <sha>; landing needs branch `<name>` checked out (the job's dispatch branch); nothing landed. Check it out, then run again`. For Dispatched::Detached or Unknown, say 'a checked-out branch' instead of the name. Avoid the word 'verification'. Add `dispatched_from(git, head, id: &JobId) -> Result<Dispatched>`: Records::load(git, head), take jobs.get(id).and_then(|j| j.job).dispatch_branch; if absent, run `git.run(["for-each-ref","--format=%(refname:short)","refs/heads"])`, and for each branch read `git.show_file(branch, &format!("{}/job.json", id.dir()))`, parse with AnyRecord::parse and take its dispatch_branch (as lifecycle.rs:1835 does); otherwise Dispatched::Unknown. Update the module doc.

land.rs tests: with base_and_candidate(), assert refuse_detached is Ok on main, and on a detached HEAD is Err containing 'detached', the short sha and `main` (Branch), and 'a checked-out branch' (Detached/Unknown), and never contains 'verification'. Add a test for the dispatched_from fallback using a committed job record, or reuse the store fixtures the file uses, if a job.json is easy to build there; otherwise cover the fallback via the drain test.

close.rs: in land_or_block, right after `let dispatched = ...`, add `crate::land::refuse_detached(&self.git, &dispatched)?;` before the for loop, with a comment on why it precedes any record or commit (a stale outcome would otherwise be committed on the detached HEAD).

drain.rs RealSteps::land: after the Stage::Landing table entry and before `self.lander.land`, run the check. Get head via self.athena.head(), parse JobId, call dispatched_from, then refuse_detached; if Dispatched::Branch(name) and current_branch is Some(other) != name, build a message naming both branches. On a refusal, remove the table row (`self.table_result(self.table().remove(job))`) and return Landing::NotLanded(message). On an Err from the check itself, return NotLanded with the error text. Keep the rest of the function unchanged.

lifecycle.rs: add the detach hook (clone of switch_to_new_branch_during_verification, using `checkout -q --detach` and recording the tip) and the two tests. The negative test asserts: Err with 'detached', 'main' in backticks and no 'verification'; `git rev-parse main` and fx.head() equal the tip; README.md lacks 'Hello, reader.'; athena.status() lists the job as interrupted after checking out main again. The positive test asserts Landed, the tip advanced from the pre-go tip, the branch is main, and README.md has the greeting.

tests/drain.rs: add the two RealSteps::land tests. Build the fixture and scenario as the_real_steps_work_a_queued_request_land_it_and_only_then_rate_the_page does (rated_scenario, queue_steward_request). Run athena.go through RealSteps::run or athena.go so the job lands locally, detach with `git checkout -q --detach`, and call steps.land(job): expect NotLanded with 'detached' and `main`, and an empty RecordingLander log. Then `git checkout -q main` and steps.land(job) returns Landed with one lander call.

CHANGELOG.md: add a Fixed entry (create the ### Fixed heading under [Unreleased] if absent) with the root cause, the failed job and the introspection record id 20261029-045649-k845, and the two places the check sits.

Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; also run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core` and `cargo test --locked -p athena-cli` to see the lifecycle, drain and land tests directly.

risks.risk: The drain-side guard changes what the drain does for a job dispatched on a detached HEAD or an old record whose dispatch branch is unknown. The unknown case still lands from a branch.
risks.mitigation: A detached HEAD is refused in all cases, as the request says. Unknown or Detached dispatch only refuses a detached HEAD and checks no branch. The behavior is limited to the refusal and mentioned in the CHANGELOG. No existing test lands from a detached HEAD (grep for --detach found only the reconcile fixtures and plan() unit tests).

risks.risk: The detach hook may leave verification or an earlier step failing on a detached HEAD before land_or_block, so the test does not reach the new guard.
risks.mitigation: The existing other-branch test uses the same hook point and reaches land_or_block. The test asserts the error text names 'detached' and `main`, so any earlier failure with a different message makes it fail rather than pass silently. If an earlier step fails, move the detach to a hook just before landing.

risks.risk: The fallback branch scan in dispatched_from could name the wrong branch when several local branches hold the job's record (as `other` did in the existing test).
risks.mitigation: Prefer the record at HEAD; the scan runs only when HEAD lacks the job. Sort the branch names and take the one whose job.json carries a non-empty dispatch_branch. The recorded dispatch_branch, not the scanned branch's own name, is what is reported.

risks.risk: Read cost and failure: the drain guard loads Records at HEAD again (RealSteps::records already does this per landing) and a git error could block landing.
risks.mitigation: The load already happens for each landing (`records()` right after). An Err from the check becomes NotLanded with the error text. It does not panic, and the drain's usual retry and stop policy applies.

risks.risk: The CHANGELOG.md or a doc test could fail a convention check (a heading or line-length scan).
risks.mitigation: Follow the existing entry layout (hanging two-space lines); the verifier runs the full `cargo test --locked`, which includes xtask policy tests.

demonstrations.method: lifecycle.rs test: Fixture::new(); a Scenario whose during_verification hook runs `git checkout -q --detach` via athena_git::Git::at(root) (as switch_to_new_branch_during_verification does for branches) and records main's tip. Call athena.ask, then athena.go. Expect Err whose `{error:#}` contains 'detached', the 12-char sha and '`main`', and not 'verification'. Then assert `git rev-parse main` equals the recorded tip, fx.head() equals the recorded tip, the git log from the tip has no commit with an 'Athena-Job' landing and README.md lacks 'Hello, reader.'. A twin test in tests/drain.rs, the_drain_step_refuses_to_land_from_a_detached_head, runs athena.go on main, detaches HEAD, calls RealSteps::land(job) with a RecordingLander and expects Landing::NotLanded whose text names the detached HEAD and `main`, with the lander never called.
demonstrations.observes: The error text names the detached HEAD and the expected branch. The branch tip is unchanged, nothing is committed, and the drain step's lander is not reached.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without refuse_detached in land_or_block, go does not return an error. It records a stale outcome on the detached HEAD (the job's records are at the detached commit). The assertions that go errors with 'detached' and `main`, that the HEAD commit is unchanged and that no landing commit exists all fail. A second test on RealSteps::land fails the same way: the recording lander is called, or land_pr reports no verification.
